name: smith reverse-grip press
description: A press with an underhand grip on the smith bar, lowering to the chest and pressing back up. It trains the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Set a flat bench in the smith machine so the bar lines up with your lower chest.
Lie back and grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
